title: Altar on Mount Ebal

questions.question: What were they to write on the large stones?
options: All the words of this law
questions.correctAnswer: All the words of this law
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:3 (ESV): "And you shall write on them all the words of this law..."

questions.question: Where was the altar to be built?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:4 (ESV): "you shall set up these stones... on Mount Ebal..."

questions.question: What kind of stones were used for the altar?
options: Uncut stones; no iron tool wielded on them
questions.correctAnswer: Uncut stones; no iron tool wielded on them
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:5–6 (ESV): "You shall not wield an iron tool on them; you shall build an altar... of uncut stones."

questions.question: Which tribes stood on Mount Gerizim to bless?
options: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin
questions.correctAnswer: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:12 lists these tribes for the blessing.

questions.question: Which tribes stood on Mount Ebal for the curse?
options: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali
questions.correctAnswer: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:13 lists these tribes for the curse.

questions.question: What does the first curse address?
options: Anyone who makes a carved or metal image (idol)
questions.correctAnswer: Anyone who makes a carved or metal image (idol)
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:15 (ESV): "Cursed be the man who makes a carved or cast metal image..."

questions.question: What must all the people say after each curse?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:15 (ESV): "And all the people shall answer and say, 'Amen.'"

questions.question: Cursed be anyone who dishonors whom?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:16 (ESV): "Cursed be anyone who dishonors his father or his mother."

questions.question: Cursed be anyone who misleads whom on the road?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:18 (ESV): "Cursed be anyone who misleads a blind man on the road."

questions.question: Cursed be anyone who accepts a bribe to do what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:25 (ESV): "Cursed be anyone who takes a bribe to shed innocent blood."

questions.question: What were the stones to be coated with?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:2 (ESV): "...set up large stones and plaster them with plaster."

questions.question: What does the final general curse cover?
options: Anyone who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them
questions.correctAnswer: Anyone who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:26 (ESV): "Cursed be anyone who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them."

questions.question: Who declared these things to all Israel?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:9 (ESV): "Then Moses and the Levitical priests said to all Israel..."

questions.question: The people are told to "Keep silence and hear" because they have become what?
options: The people of the Lord your God
questions.correctAnswer: The people of the Lord your God
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:9 (ESV): "...Receive silence (Keep silence) and hear, O Israel; this day you have become the people of the Lord your God."

questions.question: Cursed be anyone who perverts the justice due to whom?
options: The sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow
questions.correctAnswer: The sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 27:19 (ESV): "Cursed be anyone who perverts the justice due to the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow."

key_verse_text: Cursed be anyone who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them. And all the people shall say, “Amen.” (ESV)
